system.description:
PREDATOR'S POUNCE

ATTACK FLOURISH FOCUS MOVEMENT

Action 2 AP

Requirements you are able to Stride at least 10 feet towards a creature.

Stride at least 10 feet (maximum of your speed) and then make a melee Strike against the creature. The target cannot use reactions triggered by your movement.

Use: target the creature first. Checks Flourish's once-a-turn limit, spends 2 AP and this ability's Focus use (Refocus restores it), and arms your next token move — up to your land Speed, no further AP. The card then offers the melee Strike with each melee weapon you have equipped; it costs no AP, since the Pounce bought it.
